surface.usage: Cards, panels, menus, and framed tools in dark mode.

mist.usage: Body and secondary text on dark surfaces.

smoke.usage: Meta text, disabled text, and focus rings.

wine.usage: Errors, withdrawals, destructive actions, and failed live states.

sage.usage: Confirmed, saved, connected, checked in, and registered states.

clay.usage: Pending, warning, incomplete, deferred, and attention states.

display.purpose: Brand, page titles, major headings, and editorial content titles only.

body.purpose: Body text, controls, tables, lists, navigation, and operational UI.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, badges, table headers, and identifiers.

elevationMeta.strategy: Flat by default. Use tonal contrast, borders, rule lines, and occasional contextual blur instead of shadows. Menus stay opaque for readability.

componentRules.shape: Square or 2px radius for most UI. Preserve circles for avatars, toggles, progress dots, and familiar round indicators.
componentRules.color: Metals and semantic colors require domain meaning. Neutrals carry inactive UI. Use sage for confirmed/saved/live, clay for pending/warning/current attention, wine for destructive/failed, and metals for awarded or syllabus meaning only. Metals should feel polished and luminous, not muddy or dusty.
componentRules.alerts: Use full borders and tonal tints. Do not use side stripes.
componentRules.navigation: Translucent blurred background plus bottom rule.
componentRules.menus: Dropdowns, popovers, and selects use opaque surfaces so underlying text cannot compete.
componentRules.blur: Use blur for sticky chrome and modal/sheet overlays only, never as a general card or menu aesthetic.
componentRules.bolder: Amplify through clearer hierarchy, darker active states, and stronger surface contrast. Do not overscale product titles, thicken header rules, add neon, gradients, shadows, or extra decorative color.

delightRules.strategy: Subtle product moments only. Delight should appear in completion, loading, empty states, and precise hover feedback.
delightRules.loading: Skeletons use a quiet moving rule line, respect reduced motion, and never delay content.
delightRules.emptyStates: Use the atelier diamond glyph with specific guidance about what the surface becomes once populated.
delightRules.brandMark: The brand mark may respond softly on hover or keyboard focus. Keep it brief and non-decorative.

colorRules.strategy: Restrained semantic color. Color appears only for primary action, current selection, state indicators, placements, and syllabus levels.
colorRules.rawTailwindStatusColors: Do not use raw Tailwind blue, green, amber, orange, yellow, red, or emerald status colors in product UI. Map those meanings to sage, clay, wine, gold, silver, and bronze.
colorRules.utilities: Use status-sage, status-clay, status-wine, placement-gold, placement-silver, and placement-bronze for product states. Status utilities should have enough tint and border contrast to remain legible against carbon and surface panels.
